checks: Three dedicated window roles are discovered and shown at the Jarvis station.
A model command targets the right window, confirms the demo, and leaves Jarvis central.
A station keeps its role through manual navigation; an explicit right-screen request still targets that station.
Production view is acknowledged by the left window without changing the central view.
Film view opens only on the right and does not claim automatic playback.
An open editor on the receiving screen is preserved; the sender sees a rejection.
A stale revision or unknown project is rejected without replacing the active dossier.
The central visual dock sends the new 22.7-second BOJ.ART signature edit to screen 03, with receipt and arrival note; central Jarvis stays in place.
The local visual form selects the requested model; conflicting model/art requests preserve the current view and send no provider or display request.
A missing status endpoint and an unconfigured gateway keep Jev disabled; a configured gateway enables it without inventing a successful call.
An injected TypeSafe answer passes through the real server normalizer and browser validator before one model request reaches the right screen.
Uncertain and explicit none provider decisions keep the current scene and emit no cross-screen request.
A delayed Jev response for the previous dossier is refused after project synchronization, without replacing the new dossier or sending a visual command.
A delayed Jev result preserves a different open editor, including its unsaved text, and does not change another screen.
The identity drawer presents four verifiable source sequences, manual film controls, source-derived timings, and a working screen-03 presentation action.
A renderer failure is returned to Jarvis; no successful model display or local retry is invented.
An absent right window opens screen setup, preserving Jarvis and avoiding a silent local fallback.
scope: Three isolated JSDOM windows, real application/store/display controller and TypeSafe response normalizer, shared storage and BroadcastChannel double. Renderer stub and injected provider HTTP responses only; no browser, socket or live Jev request.
